title: 懸索橋主纜架設~Suspension-bridge main-cable erection
focus: 從工法選擇、裸纜幾何、鋼絲與索鞍細部，到導索貓道、擠壓纏絲、量測允收與開纜檢查的主纜架設全流程~The whole main-cable process: method choice, bare-cable geometry, wire and saddle details, pilot rope and catwalk, compaction and wrapping, survey and acceptance, and internal inspection
summary: 主纜是懸索橋唯一幾乎無法更換的主構件，它的品質在架設時就已決定。本課比較空中紡線（金門大橋、大貝爾特東橋）與預製平行鋼絲索股（明石海峽大橋、瀨戶大橋、1915 恰納卡萊大橋）兩種工法，計算裸纜懸鏈線、索鞍彎曲應力、貓道張力與擠壓後直徑，說明鋼絲等級與鍍層、索股量測與統計允收，並依美國聯邦公路總署的指引談開纜檢查、腐蝕分級與剩餘強度評估。~The main cable is the one primary member of a suspension bridge that can almost never be replaced, and its quality is fixed during erection. This course compares aerial spinning (Golden Gate, Great Belt East) with prefabricated parallel-wire strands (Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi, 1915 Çanakkale), computes bare-cable catenaries, saddle bending stress, catwalk tension and compacted diameter, explains wire grades and coatings, strand survey and statistical acceptance, and, following US Federal Highway Administration guidance, covers cable openings, corrosion staging and remaining-strength evaluation.

units.anchor: 空中紡線與預製索股~Aerial spinning versus PWS
units.title: 主纜架設工法的選擇~Choosing the cable erection method
units.mechanism: 空中紡線法讓紡線輪沿貓道上方往返，每趟帶著鋼絲環從一座錨碇走到另一座，在現場把數百根鋼絲累積成一束：金門大橋每纜 61 束、平均每束約 452 根；大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根鋼絲分成 37 束。預製平行鋼絲索股（PWS）則在工廠把鋼絲排成六角形索股並預裝錨頭，再整股牽引過海峽：明石海峽大橋每纜 290 股、瀨戶大橋與 1915 恰納卡萊大橋每股都是 127 根。空中紡線運輸輕便、錨固點少，但現場時間長且受風影響；PWS 現場快、品質在工廠控制，但索股重、錨頭多，需要大型捲盤與牽引設備。~Aerial spinning runs spinning wheels back and forth above the catwalk, each trip carrying a loop of wire from one anchorage to the other, building bundles of several hundred wires on site: Golden Gate has 61 strands per cable averaging about 452 wires, and the Great Belt East Bridge splits 18,648 wires per cable into 37 bundles. Prefabricated parallel-wire strands (PWS) are laid up in the factory into hexagonal strands with sockets already fitted, then hauled across whole: Akashi Kaikyo has 290 strands per cable, and Seto Ohashi and the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge both use 127 wires per strand. Aerial spinning needs only light transport and few anchorage points but long, wind-sensitive site work; PWS is fast on site with factory-controlled quality but has heavy strands and many sockets, needing large reels and hauling gear.
units.model: 設主纜需 36,000 根鋼絲。PWS 每股 127 根需 36,000/127 ≈ 284 股、兩端共 568 個錨頭；空中紡線每束約 500 根只需 72 束、144 個索靴。若紡線輪每趟鋪 4 根鋼絲，空中紡線需約 36,000/4 = 9,000 趟，而 PWS 只需 284 次牽引。數值為教學假設。~Suppose a cable needs 36,000 wires. PWS with 127 per strand needs 36,000/127 ≈ 284 strands and 568 sockets at the two ends; aerial spinning with about 500 per bundle needs only 72 bundles and 144 strand shoes. If each wheel trip lays 4 wires, spinning needs about 36,000/4 = 9,000 trips, against 284 hauls for PWS. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以工期、氣象紀錄（可作業風速天數）、航道限制、運輸路線承重、錨碇空間與錨頭數量做工法比選矩陣，並估算每種工法的現場人時與風險；選定後由設計者確認錨碇與索鞍細部符合所選工法。~Build a comparison matrix of programme, weather records (days with workable wind), navigation limits, transport-route capacity, anchorage space and socket count, estimating site man-hours and risk for each method; once chosen, the designer confirms that anchorage and saddle details suit the method.
units.failure: 在強風頻繁的海峽採用空中紡線而未預留停工天數，進度落後時容易壓縮垂度調整時間；採用 PWS 卻低估捲盤重量與運輸限制，可能必須縮短索股長度或增加接頭，影響錨固設計。~Choosing aerial spinning over a windy strait without allowing for downtime tempts crews to cut sag adjustment when behind; choosing PWS while underestimating reel weight and transport limits may force shorter strands or extra splices that affect anchorage design.
units.misconception: 預製索股一定比空中紡線先進，任何橋都應該使用。~Prefabricated strands are always more advanced and should be used on every bridge.
units.practice: 工法比選應在基本設計階段完成，並把結果寫入錨碇、索鞍與貓道的設計條件；投標文件可允許替代工法，但必須要求承包商提出相應的錨固與幾何控制方案，並經設計者核可。~Settle the method comparison at basic design and write the outcome into the design conditions for anchorages, saddles and catwalks; tender documents may allow alternatives, but the contractor must then submit matching anchorage and geometry-control proposals for the designer's approval.

units.title: 裸纜幾何：懸鏈線與拋物線~Bare-cable geometry: catenary versus parabola
units.mechanism: 主纜在橋面掛上之前只承受自重，自重沿纜長均勻分布，形狀是懸鏈線；掛上沿水平均勻分布的橋面後，形狀才接近拋物線。設計者先決定完工狀態的線形，再以逆向分析扣除橋面荷重與彈性伸長，求出主纜在無應力狀態下的長度，以及裸纜階段各跨應有的垂度與索鞍位置。架設時第一根基準索股或基準鋼絲就是按這個裸纜幾何設定，之後所有鋼絲都以它為準，因此裸纜計算的誤差會一路傳到完工線形。~Before the deck is hung, the main cable carries only its own weight, distributed evenly along its length, so its shape is a catenary; once a deck load distributed evenly along the horizontal is added, the shape approaches a parabola. Designers fix the completed profile first, then back-analyse by removing deck load and elastic stretch to find the unstressed cable length and the bare-cable sag and saddle positions for each span. The first reference strand or reference wire is set to this bare-cable geometry and every later wire follows it, so errors in the bare-cable calculation pass straight into the final profile.
units.model: 取裸纜自重 w = 35 kN/m、水平張力 H = 70,000 kN、跨徑 l = 1,600 m。拋物線 f_p = w·l²/(8H) = 35×1,600²/560,000 = 160.0 m；懸鏈線 f_c = (H/w)·[cosh(w·l/(2H)) − 1] = 2,000×(cosh 0.4 − 1) = 2,000×0.0811 ≈ 162.1 m，相差約 2.1 m（1.3%）。數值為教學假設。~Take bare-cable weight w = 35 kN/m, horizontal tension H = 70,000 kN and span l = 1,600 m. The parabola gives f_p = w·l²/(8H) = 35×1,600²/560,000 = 160.0 m; the catenary gives f_c = (H/w)·[cosh(w·l/(2H)) − 1] = 2,000×(cosh 0.4 − 1) = 2,000×0.0811 ≈ 162.1 m, a difference of about 2.1 m (1.3%). Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以兩套獨立程式（例如設計者與承包商各自的非線性分析）計算無應力纜長與裸纜垂度，比較結果；基準索股架設後量測各跨垂度與索鞍位置，經溫度修正後與計算值比較，差異超過允差時先複核計算假設再調整。~Compute unstressed cable length and bare-cable sag with two independent programs, such as the designer's and the contractor's nonlinear analyses, and compare; after the reference strand is erected, measure sag in each span and saddle positions, correct for temperature and compare with calculation, re-checking assumptions before adjusting when differences exceed tolerance.
units.failure: 若裸纜階段直接用拋物線公式設定基準索股，在大跨中會產生公尺級的垂度誤差，完工後橋面高程與吊索長度都對不上；忽略索鞍與錨碇處的實際幾何（切點位置、分束長度）也會造成同樣的系統誤差。~Setting the reference strand with the parabola formula in the bare-cable stage creates sag errors of the order of metres on a long span, so deck levels and hanger lengths do not match at completion; ignoring the real geometry at saddles and anchorages, such as tangent points and splay lengths, causes similar systematic errors.
units.misconception: 主纜在任何階段都是拋物線，差別可以忽略。~The cable is a parabola at every stage, and the difference is negligible.
units.practice: 架設手冊應列出裸纜階段的目標垂度、索鞍預偏量、參考溫度與量測點位置，並附上兩套獨立計算的比對結果；基準索股定位是全工程最重要的停留點之一，須由設計者與監造共同見證。~The erection manual should list target bare-cable sags, saddle offsets, reference temperature and survey points, with the comparison of two independent calculations; setting the reference strand is one of the most important hold points of the whole job and must be witnessed jointly by the designer and the supervising engineer.

units.anchor: 鋼絲等級與鍍鋅層~Wire grade and zinc coating
units.title: 主纜鋼絲的強度等級與鍍層~Strength grades and coatings of cable wire
units.mechanism: 主纜鋼絲是經鉛浴或替代熱處理、冷拉成形的高碳鋼絲，再熱浸鍍鋅。日本製鐵的技術報告指出，日本約半世紀使用 1,570 MPa 級鋼絲，1,770 MPa 級 5 mm 鋼絲首次用於明石海峽大橋，近年已試製 1,960 MPa 級；長大橋鋼絲的鍍鋅量一般在 300 g/m² 以上，近年也採用鋅鋁合金鍍層。強度越高，所需鋼絲越少、自重越輕，但對缺口、氫脆與彎曲越敏感，扭轉與伸長率等延性指標必須同時控制。鍍層是犧牲性防蝕，架設時的刮傷會成為日後腐蝕的起點。~Cable wire is high-carbon steel, heat-treated by lead patenting or an alternative, cold-drawn and hot-dip galvanised. A Nippon Steel technical report notes that Japan used 1,570 MPa wire for about half a century, that 1,770 MPa 5 mm wire was first used on the Akashi Kaikyo Bridge, and that 1,960 MPa wire has since been trial-produced; long-span bridge wire usually carries 300 g/m² or more of zinc, with zinc–aluminium coatings used in recent years. Higher strength means fewer wires and less self-weight but more sensitivity to notches, hydrogen embrittlement and bending, so ductility indicators such as torsion and elongation must be controlled too. The coating is sacrificial, and scratches during erection become future corrosion sites.
units.model: 金門大橋鋼絲鍍鋅厚度約 0.002 in = 50.8 μm，以鋅密度 7.14 g/cm³ 換算約 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m²，符合 300 g/m² 以上的常見水準。若同一主纜由 1,570 MPa 改用 1,960 MPa 鋼絲而破斷力不變，鋼絲面積可減少 1 − 1,570/1,960 ≈ 20%。~Golden Gate wire carries about 0.002 in = 50.8 μm of zinc, which at a zinc density of 7.14 g/cm³ is about 50.8×7.14 ≈ 363 g/m², in line with the usual 300 g/m² or more. Replacing 1,570 MPa wire with 1,960 MPa wire at the same breaking force cuts wire area by 1 − 1,570/1,960 ≈ 20%.
units.verify: 每捲鋼絲抽驗直徑、抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與捲繞試驗、鍍層附著量與附著性；架設前後在牽引路徑上的導輪、索鞍槽與擠壓機接觸面檢查刮傷，並抽樣量測鍍層厚度。~Sample each coil for diameter, tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and wrapping tests, coating mass and adhesion; before and after erection inspect rollers, saddle grooves and compactor contact surfaces along the hauling path for scratches, sampling coating thickness.
units.failure: 鍍鋅層在牽引或擠壓時被大面積刮除，日後在纜內潮濕環境中最先出現鏽點；超高強度鋼絲若延性不足，在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處可能脆斷，而且斷絲藏在纜內不易被發現。~Large areas of zinc scraped off during hauling or compaction are where rust first appears in a damp cable; ultra-high-strength wire with poor ductility can break brittly where it bends locally at saddles or bands, hidden inside the cable.
units.misconception: 鍍鋅只是外觀處理，對主纜壽命影響不大。~Galvanising is cosmetic and hardly affects cable life.
units.practice: 鋼絲規格須同時訂定強度、延性與鍍層指標及抽樣頻率，並要求從線材爐號到成品捲號的完整追溯；牽引與擠壓設備的接觸面材料與狀態應列入每日檢查表。~The wire specification must set strength, ductility and coating requirements with sampling frequencies and require full traceability from rod heat to finished coil; the material and condition of contact surfaces on hauling and compaction equipment belong on the daily checklist.

units.anchor: 索鞍半徑與彎曲應力~Saddle radius and bending stress
units.title: 索鞍、分束與錨固細部~Saddles, splay and anchorage details
units.mechanism: 主纜在塔頂索鞍處改變方向，在錨碇前的分束鞍處散開成一束束，再以索靴（空中紡線）或錨頭（預製索股）連接到錨碇拉桿。鋼絲繞過彎曲面時，除了軸向應力外還有與曲率成正比的彎曲應力，並在接觸面上承受側壓與摩擦；索鞍槽的半徑、隔板與填充材決定這些附加應力的大小，也決定主纜在索鞍內是否會滑動。分束處的鋼絲排列若與錨固點對不上，部分鋼絲會被拉長、部分鬆弛。~The main cable changes direction at the tower-top saddles and fans out at splay saddles in front of the anchorages, where bundles connect to anchor rods through strand shoes (aerial spinning) or sockets (PWS). Where wires pass over a curved surface they carry bending stress proportional to curvature on top of axial stress, plus side pressure and friction at the contact; saddle groove radius, spacers and fillers set the size of these extra stresses and whether the cable slips in the saddle. If the wire arrangement at the splay does not match the anchorage points, some wires are stretched and others go slack.
units.model: 鋼絲繞過半徑 R 的彎曲面時，表面彎曲應力 σ_b = E·d/(2R)。取 E = 200,000 N/mm²、d = 5.4 mm：R = 3.0 m 時 σ_b = 200,000×5.4/6,000 = 180 N/mm²；R = 1.0 m 時增為 540 N/mm²，加上約 700 N/mm² 的軸向應力就逼近降伏。數值為教學假設。~A wire bent over radius R has surface bending stress σ_b = E·d/(2R). With E = 200,000 N/mm² and d = 5.4 mm: R = 3.0 m gives σ_b = 200,000×5.4/6,000 = 180 N/mm²; R = 1.0 m gives 540 N/mm², which on top of about 700 N/mm² axial stress approaches yield. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 索鞍與分束鞍以鑄造或焊接製造後，量測槽半徑、隔板位置與表面粗糙度，並以全尺寸或縮尺模型試驗確認抗滑係數；錨頭（澆鑄鋅或環氧樹脂鋼球）抽樣做靜力與疲勞拉拔試驗，記錄錨頭回縮量。~After casting or welding saddles and splay saddles, measure groove radius, spacer positions and surface roughness, and confirm slip resistance by full- or reduced-scale tests; sample sockets, whether zinc-cast or epoxy–steel-ball, for static and fatigue pull-out tests, recording socket draw-in.
units.failure: 索鞍槽半徑過小或邊緣倒角不足，鋼絲在長期車流與溫度循環下於彎曲處疲勞斷絲；鞍內填充不實時，主纜在不平衡荷重下滑動，改變兩側垂度並損傷鍍層；錨頭灌注不良則可能使鋼絲從錨頭拔出。~A saddle groove with too small a radius or poor edge rounding lets wires fatigue and break at the bend under years of traffic and thermal cycles; incomplete filling in the saddle lets the cable slip under unbalanced load, changing sags on both sides and damaging coating; poorly filled sockets can let wires pull out.
units.misconception: 鋼絲只承受軸向拉力，索鞍形狀不影響應力。~Cable wires carry only axial tension, so saddle shape does not affect stress.
units.practice: 索鞍、分束鞍與錨固細部應在設計圖中標明最小彎曲半徑、鋼絲排列圖與抗滑檢核，並把錨頭試驗、錨頭回縮量與錨固位置列為停留點；完工後保留可目視錨頭與索靴的檢查通道。~Drawings for saddles, splay saddles and anchorage details should show minimum bending radius, wire arrangement and slip checks, with socket tests, draw-in and anchorage positions as hold points; keep inspection access to see sockets and strand shoes after completion.

units.anchor: 導索跨越與貓道~Pilot-rope crossing and catwalk
units.title: 導索、貓道與牽引系統~Pilot rope, catwalk and hauling system
units.mechanism: 主纜架設的第一步是把一條細導索跨過兩座塔：早期做法是讓導索浮在浮筒上以船拖過，必須封閉航道；瀨戶大橋改以起重船把導索吊高跨越，本州四國連絡橋在潮流強、船多的海域也以直升機牽引導索。導索就位後依序拉上較粗的鋼索，架成貓道：瀨戶大橋的貓道由約 10 條鋼索承托，鋪鋼絲網與雙層纖維網，寬 4.5 m、扶手高 1.4 m，並以橫向便橋連接。貓道本身就是一座臨時懸索橋，其線形必須與主纜平行，並能承受作業荷重與強風。~The first step of cable erection is to get a thin pilot rope across the two towers: the old way floated it on buoys and towed it across by boat, closing the channel; Seto Ohashi held it high from a crane ship instead, and in Honshu-Shikoku waters with strong currents and heavy traffic it was also flown across by helicopter. Heavier ropes are then pulled across in turn to build the catwalk: Seto Ohashi's catwalks rested on about ten ropes with wire mesh and a double fibre net, 4.5 m wide with 1.4 m handrails, linked by cross-bridges. A catwalk is itself a temporary suspension bridge whose profile must parallel the main cable and carry working loads and strong wind.
units.model: 貓道承載索水平張力 H = w·l²/(8f)。取每座貓道自重加作業荷重 w = 1.2 kN/m、跨徑 l = 1,500 m、垂度 f = 150 m：H = 1.2×1,500²/(8×150) = 2,250 kN；若分由 10 條鋼索承擔，每條約 225 kN。垂度若減為 140 m，H 增為約 2,411 kN。數值為教學假設。~Catwalk rope horizontal tension H = w·l²/(8f). With self-weight plus working load w = 1.2 kN/m per catwalk, span l = 1,500 m and sag f = 150 m: H = 1.2×1,500²/(8×150) = 2,250 kN, about 225 kN for each of ten ropes. Reducing the sag to 140 m raises H to about 2,411 kN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 導索跨越前取得海事主管機關的作業許可與航行警告，跨越時量測導索最低點高程；貓道完成後檢查網片、扶手與橫向便橋的固定，量測貓道線形與主纜設計線形的間距，並以風速計設定作業與撤離門檻。~Before the crossing obtain marine-authority approval and a navigation warning, measuring the rope's lowest point during the crossing; after the catwalk is built inspect mesh, handrails and cross-bridge fixings, measure the gap between catwalk profile and the design cable profile, and set work and evacuation thresholds with anemometers.
units.failure: 導索在跨越時下垂進入航道淨空可能勾到船舶；貓道與主纜線形不平行，鋼絲在某些區段會摩擦網片或被迫偏折；強風中貓道過度擺動，曾在多座橋的施工中造成停工與設備損壞。~A pilot rope sagging into the navigation clearance can snag a ship; a catwalk not parallel to the cable makes wires rub the mesh or bend in places; excessive catwalk sway in strong wind has stopped work and damaged equipment on many bridge projects.
units.misconception: 貓道只是臨時走道，可以用一般鷹架的標準設計。~A catwalk is only a temporary walkway and can be designed like ordinary scaffolding.
units.practice: 貓道屬於臨時結構，須有獨立設計計算、抗風穩定檢核、每日檢查表與撤離程序，並由臨時工程設計者簽認；牽引系統的最大拉力、制動與通訊要在試運轉中驗證後才可牽引第一股。~A catwalk is temporary works needing its own design calculations, wind-stability check, daily checklist and evacuation procedure signed by the temporary-works designer; the hauling system's maximum pull, braking and communications must be proven in a trial run before the first strand is hauled.

units.title: 主纜擠壓、纏絲與索夾安裝~Compaction, wrapping and cable-band installation
units.mechanism: 所有鋼絲架好後，主纜還是由許多六角形或圓形的束鬆散組成，需要以液壓擠壓機沿全長逐段把它壓成接近圓形的緊密斷面，並暫時以鋼帶綁住。擠壓品質決定空隙率：空隙太大，水分容易進入並滯留在纜內；擠壓不均則讓索夾無法均勻夾緊。之後安裝索夾（兩個半圓柱以螺栓夾緊，坡度越陡需要越多螺栓），掛上吊索，最後以纏絲機把鍍鋅軟鋼線（美國常用 No. 9 線）緊密纏繞在主纜外，並塗上防蝕膏與塗料，或改用彈性體包覆配合乾燥空氣。~Once all wires are in place, the cable is still a loose group of hexagonal or round bundles, and hydraulic compactors work along its length to press it into a dense, nearly round section, temporarily banded with steel straps. Compaction sets the void ratio: too many voids let water enter and stay in the cable, and uneven compaction stops cable bands from clamping evenly. Cable bands are then installed, two half-cylinders bolted together, with more bolts on steeper slopes, the hangers are hung, and finally a wrapping machine winds soft galvanised wire (No. 9 wire in US practice) tightly around the cable over a corrosion-inhibiting paste and paint, or an elastomeric wrap is used with dry air.
units.model: 主纜直徑 D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]。取 18,000 根 5.4 mm 鋼絲，a = 22.90 mm²，鋼絲面積 0.4122 m²：空隙率 v = 18% 時 D ≈ √(4×0.4122/(π×0.82)) ≈ 0.800 m；v = 22% 時 D ≈ 0.820 m。直徑差 20 mm 就代表索夾內徑與螺栓夾緊量需要重新核對。數值為教學假設。~Cable diameter D = √[4·N·a/(π·(1 − v))]. With 18,000 wires of 5.4 mm, a = 22.90 mm² and a steel area of 0.4122 m²: a void ratio v = 18% gives D ≈ √(4×0.4122/(π×0.82)) ≈ 0.800 m, while v = 22% gives D ≈ 0.820 m. A 20 mm difference means cable-band bore and bolt clamping must be re-checked. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 擠壓後沿全長以周長尺或雷射量測直徑與橢圓度，換算空隙率並與允收範圍比較；索夾安裝時依程序分次張拉螺栓並記錄，纏絲時量測纏絲張力、搭接與間距，逐段拍照存檔。~After compaction measure diameter and ovality along the length with a circumference tape or laser, convert to void ratio and compare with the acceptance range; tension cable-band bolts in stages per procedure and record them, and during wrapping measure wrapping tension, laps and pitch, photographing each section for the record.
units.failure: 擠壓不足的區段在完工後仍持續壓密，索夾螺栓預力隨之流失，索夾可能下滑；纏絲間隙或防蝕膏不連續處成為水分入口，主纜低點與索夾下方最先出現腐蝕。~Under-compacted sections keep consolidating after completion, so cable-band bolt preload is lost and bands may slip; gaps in wrapping or breaks in the paste become water entry points, and corrosion appears first at cable low points and under bands.
units.misconception: 主纜擠壓只是為了外觀圓整，對耐久性影響不大。~Compaction is only to make the cable look round and hardly affects durability.
units.practice: 擠壓與纏絲應列為逐段驗收項目，直徑、空隙率、螺栓張力與纏絲紀錄須能追溯到區段編號；索夾螺栓應在完工後一定期間（例如數月內）複測一次預力，以補償初期壓密造成的損失。~Make compaction and wrapping section-by-section acceptance items, with diameter, void ratio, bolt tension and wrapping records traceable to section numbers; re-check cable-band bolt preload within a set period after completion, for example within a few months, to make up for losses from early consolidation.

units.anchor: 索股垂度量測精度~Strand sag survey accuracy
units.title: 基準索股與相對垂度量測~Reference strand and relative sag survey
units.mechanism: 主纜每一股（或每一束）都要與基準索股的垂度一致，量測分兩層：基準索股以全站儀或精密水準做絕對量測，其餘索股則以安裝在跨中與邊跨的量規或雷射，量測與基準索股的相對高差。絕對量測的誤差主要來自儀器角度精度、距離、大氣折射與目標偏心；相對量測較不受大氣影響，但量規本身的定位與讀值方法必須統一。量測結果要與溫度紀錄一起判讀，並在調整後重新量測確認。~Every strand or bundle must match the sag of the reference strand, and the survey works in two layers: the reference strand is measured absolutely by total station or precise levelling, while the others are measured relative to it with gauges or lasers mounted at mid-span and in the side spans. Absolute survey error comes mainly from instrument angular accuracy, distance, atmospheric refraction and target eccentricity; relative measurement is less affected by the atmosphere, but gauge positioning and reading method must be standardised. Results are interpreted with temperature records and re-measured after adjustment.
units.model: 角度誤差造成的位置誤差 e ≈ D·θ。全站儀角度精度 1″（4.85×10⁻⁶ rad）、視距 800 m：e ≈ 800×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.9 mm；若視距 1,600 m，e ≈ 7.8 mm。若索股相對高差允差為 ±10 mm，絕對量測在長視距下就會吃掉大部分允差，因此其他索股改用相對量測。數值為教學假設。~Position error from angular error e ≈ D·θ. With 1″ angular accuracy (4.85×10⁻⁶ rad) at 800 m, e ≈ 800×4.85×10⁻⁶ ≈ 3.9 mm; at 1,600 m, e ≈ 7.8 mm. With a ±10 mm tolerance on relative strand level, absolute survey over long sights consumes most of the tolerance, which is why the other strands are measured relatively. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 量測前以已知點校核儀器與量規，量測時記錄氣溫、索股溫度、風速與時間，同一點由兩組人員獨立讀值；每股調整後的相對高差與基準索股的絕對量測定期交叉核對，發現系統偏差時追查量規或基準點。~Check instruments and gauges against known points before surveying; during the survey log air and strand temperature, wind and time, with two crews reading the same point independently; periodically cross-check adjusted relative levels against absolute surveys of the reference strand and trace gauges or benchmarks when a systematic offset appears.
units.failure: 若基準索股量測含系統誤差，之後所有索股都會跟著錯，最後整條主纜垂度偏離設計；相對量規若在多股之後鬆動未被發現，造成一連串索股同向偏差，擠壓成纜後部分鋼絲受力過大。~A systematic error in the reference-strand survey carries into every strand that follows, leaving the whole cable off design sag; a relative gauge that loosens unnoticed after several strands produces a run of strands offset the same way, overloading some wires once compacted.
units.misconception: 儀器越精密，就不需要相對量測與交叉核對。~With precise enough instruments, relative measurement and cross-checks are unnecessary.
units.practice: 量測程序書應明訂儀器精度、量測時段、兩組獨立讀值、允差與交叉核對頻率；任何連續數股同向偏差都應觸發停工檢查，由測量主管與設計代表共同判定後才繼續。~The survey procedure should define instrument accuracy, measuring windows, two independent readings, tolerances and cross-check frequency; any run of strands deviating the same way should trigger a stop, resumed only after the survey lead and the designer's representative agree.

units.anchor: 鋼絲批次允收~Wire lot acceptance
units.title: 鋼絲批次試驗與統計允收~Wire lot testing and statistical acceptance
units.mechanism: 主纜由數萬根鋼絲組成，設計使用的是規格的最低強度或特徵值，而不是平均值；鋼絲強度呈統計分布，同一批次內也有差異。因此允收不能只看平均值，必須估計低分位值是否高於規格，並同時檢查伸長率、扭轉次數等延性指標與鍍層。製造過程任一環節（線材成分、熱處理、拉拔、鍍鋅）改變，都可能讓分布偏移，所以批次劃分與追溯同樣重要。~A main cable contains tens of thousands of wires, and design uses the specified minimum or characteristic strength rather than the mean; wire strength follows a statistical distribution and varies within a lot. Acceptance therefore cannot rely on the mean alone: the lower fractile must be shown to exceed the specification, while ductility indicators such as elongation and torsion turns and the coating are checked too. A change in any manufacturing step, whether rod chemistry, heat treatment, drawing or galvanising, can shift the distribution, so lot definition and traceability matter as much.
units.model: 以常態分布估算 5% 分位值 f_k = f_m − 1.645·s。若某批平均強度 f_m = 1,860 N/mm²、標準差 s = 30 N/mm²：f_k = 1,860 − 1.645×30 ≈ 1,811 N/mm²，高於 1,770 N/mm² 的規格值；若 s 增為 55 N/mm²，f_k ≈ 1,770 N/mm²，剛好落在門檻。數值為教學假設。~Estimate the 5% fractile from a normal distribution f_k = f_m − 1.645·s. For a lot with mean f_m = 1,860 N/mm² and standard deviation s = 30 N/mm²: f_k = 1,860 − 1.645×30 ≈ 1,811 N/mm², above a 1,770 N/mm² specification; if s grows to 55 N/mm², f_k ≈ 1,770 N/mm², right at the threshold. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 依規格的抽樣頻率從每捲或每批取樣，做拉伸、扭轉、捲繞與鍍層試驗，計算平均、標準差與低分位值；趨勢圖顯示批間偏移時追查製程紀錄，並由第三方見證部分試驗，結果連同捲號納入追溯資料庫。~Sample each coil or lot at the specified frequency for tensile, torsion, wrapping and coating tests, computing mean, standard deviation and lower fractile; when trend charts show drift between lots, trace process records, have a third party witness part of the testing, and store results with coil numbers in the traceability database.
units.failure: 只檢查平均值的允收方式，可能放行標準差過大的批次，使一部分鋼絲實際強度低於規格；延性不合格的鋼絲在架設時看不出問題，卻可能在索鞍、索夾的局部彎曲處提早斷裂。~Accepting on the mean alone can pass lots with too much scatter, leaving some wires below specification; wire with inadequate ductility looks fine during erection but may break early where it bends locally at saddles and bands.
units.misconception: 只要平均強度高於規格，整批鋼絲就合格。~If the mean strength is above specification, the whole lot passes.
units.practice: 採購規範應明訂批次定義、抽樣頻率、統計允收準則與不合格批的處置（隔離、加倍抽樣或退貨），並要求製造商提交製程能力資料；允收紀錄須保存到橋梁使用年限結束。~The procurement specification should define lots, sampling frequency, statistical acceptance criteria and disposal of failed lots (quarantine, double sampling or rejection), and require process-capability data from the maker; acceptance records must be kept for the bridge's whole service life.

units.title: 主纜內部檢查與腐蝕分級~Internal cable inspection and corrosion staging
units.mechanism: 主纜外表的纏絲與塗裝看不出內部狀況，唯一直接的方法是拆開包覆、以楔子撐開鋼絲檢查。美國聯邦公路總署的入門手冊建議首次內部檢查每條主纜至少三處，每處在周圍四個位置打入楔子；若腐蝕超過第 2 級，開口擴大到整個格間並使用八條楔線。腐蝕分為四級：第 1 級鋼絲表面有白點，第 2 級整個表面白色鋅氧化，第 3 級部分出現褐色鏽點，第 4 級褐色鏽點覆蓋 3 至 6 in 長度內超過 30% 的表面。實驗顯示約 60% 的第 4 級鋼絲可能含有裂紋。~Wrapping and paint hide the inside of a cable, and the only direct method is to remove the covering and drive wedges to spread the wires. The US Federal Highway Administration primer recommends that a first internal inspection open at least three locations per cable, with wedges at four points around the circumference; if corrosion exceeds Stage 2, the opening extends to a full panel with eight wedge lines. Corrosion has four stages: Stage 1 white spots on the wire surface, Stage 2 white zinc oxide over the whole surface, Stage 3 some brown rust spots, and Stage 4 brown spots covering more than 30% of a 3 to 6 in length of wire. Laboratory tests showed that about 60% of Stage 4 wires may contain cracks.
units.model: 估算楔線可見鋼絲的比例。主纜半徑 0.4 m、鋼絲直徑 5.4 mm，徑向約 0.4/0.0054 ≈ 74 層；每條楔線兩側各見一根，約 148 根；8 條楔線約 1,185 根，佔 18,000 根的約 6.6%。這說明開纜檢查是抽樣，需要統計推估全斷面。數值為教學假設。~Estimate the share of wires seen along wedge lines. With a 0.4 m cable radius and 5.4 mm wire there are about 0.4/0.0054 ≈ 74 radial layers; each wedge line shows one wire on each side, about 148 wires; eight lines show about 1,185 wires, about 6.6% of 18,000. Cable openings are therefore a sample, and the whole section must be inferred statistically. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 開纜位置優先選在主纜低點、索夾附近與歷史漏水處；每條楔線逐層記錄腐蝕等級與斷絲，取出代表性鋼絲做拉伸與裂紋檢查；首次基準檢查建議在約 30 年時進行，若第 4 級鋼絲超過 10%，下次間隔縮短到 5 年。~Choose openings at cable low points, near cable bands and where leaks have been recorded; log corrosion stage and broken wires layer by layer along each wedge line and remove representative wires for tensile and crack tests; the baseline internal inspection is suggested at about 30 years, with the interval shortened to five years if more than 10% of wires are Stage 4.
units.failure: 若只在容易到達的高處開纜，可能錯過積水最嚴重的低點；檢查後重新包覆不良，開口本身反而成為新的進水點；把第 4 級鋼絲當作完好鋼絲計算，會高估主纜強度。~Opening only where access is easy can miss the wettest low points; poor rewrapping after inspection turns the opening into a new water entry; counting Stage 4 wires as sound overstates cable strength.
units.misconception: 主纜外觀完好、塗裝沒有剝落，內部鋼絲就一定沒有腐蝕。~If the cable looks sound and its paint is intact, the wires inside cannot be corroded.
units.practice: 開纜檢查計畫應說明位置選擇理由、楔線數量、記錄格式、取樣鋼絲數與重新包覆的品質要求，並由具主纜檢查經驗的工程師主持；所有開口位置與結果須標示在主纜展開圖上供日後比較。~The cable-opening plan should justify locations, wedge-line count, record format, number of sampled wires and rewrapping quality, led by an engineer experienced in cable inspection; mark every opening and its findings on a developed cable drawing for later comparison.

units.anchor: 剩餘強度與聲學監測~Remaining strength and acoustic monitoring
units.title: 主纜剩餘強度評估與交接~Remaining-strength evaluation and handover
units.mechanism: 主纜剩餘強度評估把開纜觀察、鋼絲試驗與統計模型結合起來。美國的 NCHRP 534 號報告提出三種模型：裂紋鋼絲不超過總數約 10% 時可用簡化模型，它在多數情況下低估強度，適合找出最不利格間；超過時改用脆性鋼絲模型；鋼絲強度變異異常時用有限延性模型。聯邦公路總署建議在發現第 3 級以上腐蝕時裝設聲學監測，在下次開纜前持續 12 至 18 個月；當第 4 級鋼絲超過 10% 或格間內出現斷絲時，強烈建議以聲學監測偵測斷絲。這些資料都必須在交接時從施工記錄開始累積。~Remaining-strength evaluation combines cable observations, wire tests and statistical models. US NCHRP Report 534 offers three: a simplified model when cracked wires are no more than about 10% of the total, which usually underestimates strength and is useful for finding the worst panel; a brittle-wire model beyond that; and a limited-ductility model when wire strength varies unusually. The Federal Highway Administration recommends acoustic monitoring once Stage 3 or worse corrosion is found, running 12 to 18 months before the next opening, and strongly recommends it for detecting wire breaks when Stage 4 wires exceed 10% or broken wires appear in a panel. All these data must accumulate from the construction records handed over at completion.
units.model: 簡化估算：18,000 根鋼絲中 2% 斷絲（360 根）、10% 為第 4 級（1,800 根），其中 60% 含裂紋（1,080 根）且假設僅剩 50% 強度。有效鋼絲 = 18,000 − 360 − 1,080×0.5 = 17,100 根，強度剩 95%；原安全係數 2.5 降為約 2.375。若斷絲增為 5%，有效鋼絲 16,560 根，係數約 2.30。數值為教學假設。~Simplified estimate: of 18,000 wires, 2% are broken (360) and 10% are Stage 4 (1,800), of which 60% are cracked (1,080) and assumed to keep 50% strength. Effective wires = 18,000 − 360 − 1,080×0.5 = 17,100, or 95% of strength, so a 2.5 safety factor falls to about 2.375. If broken wires rise to 5%, effective wires are 16,560 and the factor is about 2.30. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以開纜位置的逐層紀錄與試驗結果建立各格間的強度估計，標出最不利格間；聲學監測系統需先做斷絲模擬試驗確認偵測率與定位精度，運轉期間把事件位置與時間標在主纜展開圖上，與下一次開纜結果對照。~Build strength estimates for each panel from layer-by-layer opening records and test results, identifying the worst panel; validate an acoustic monitoring system with simulated wire breaks to confirm detection rate and location accuracy, then plot events by position and time on the developed cable drawing and compare with the next opening.
units.failure: 缺少施工時的鋼絲批次、空隙率與纏絲紀錄，評估者只能用保守假設，可能導致不必要的限載或過晚的介入；聲學事件若未與檢查結果比對，誤報與漏報都無法被修正。~Without construction records of wire lots, void ratio and wrapping, evaluators must use conservative assumptions that can cause needless load limits or late intervention; acoustic events never compared with inspection results leave false alarms and missed breaks uncorrected.
units.misconception: 主纜強度在完工時就確定，之後只需目視檢查外觀。~Cable strength is fixed at completion, so only visual checks of the outside are needed afterwards.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含主纜展開圖、各束或各股的鋼絲數與批號、量測與允收紀錄、擠壓與纏絲紀錄、索夾螺栓張力，以及建議的首次開纜時間；營運單位據此建立主纜資料庫，每次檢查與監測都回寫更新。~Handover documents should contain the developed cable drawing, wire count and lot numbers per strand or bundle, survey and acceptance records, compaction and wrapping records, cable-band bolt tensions and the recommended time of the first opening; the operator builds a cable database from them and updates it after every inspection and monitoring campaign.

example: 設計練習：比較兩種工法完成同一條主纜的現場作業量。主纜需 36,000 根直徑 5.4 mm 的鋼絲，鋼絲面積 36,000×22.90 mm² ≈ 824,000 mm²，以 1,770 N/mm² 計破斷力 ≈ 1,459 MN。PWS 方案每股 127 根，需 284 股（最後一股不足 127 根時仍要一個完整錨頭），兩端共 568 個錨頭；若每夜牽引 4 股，約需 71 夜。空中紡線方案每束約 500 根，需 72 束、144 個索靴；若每日可鋪 1,600 根全長鋼絲，約需 36,000/1,600 ≈ 23 個有效工作日，但若可作業日比例只有 60%，實際約需 38 日曆天，並需加上每束垂度調整。擠壓後空隙率 20% 時主纜直徑 ≈ √(4×0.824/(π×0.80)) ≈ 1.15 m。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際橋梁的施工紀錄。~Design exercise: compare site effort for the two methods on the same cable. The cable needs 36,000 wires of 5.4 mm, a steel area of 36,000×22.90 mm² ≈ 824,000 mm² and, at 1,770 N/mm², a breaking force ≈ 1,459 MN. The PWS option with 127 wires per strand needs 284 strands (the last, though short of 127 wires, still needs a full socket), 568 sockets at the two ends; at 4 strands a night it takes about 71 nights. The aerial-spinning option with about 500 wires per bundle needs 72 bundles and 144 strand shoes; laying 1,600 full-length wires a day takes about 36,000/1,600 ≈ 23 working days, but if only 60% of days are workable it takes about 38 calendar days, plus sag adjustment for each bundle. With 20% voids after compaction the cable diameter is ≈ √(4×0.824/(π×0.80)) ≈ 1.15 m. Values are teaching assumptions, not construction records of any real bridge.
history: 以平行鋼絲在現場紡成主纜的方法由 Roebling 父子在 19 世紀發展，1883 年通車的布魯克林大橋首度以鍍鋅鋼絲紡線；1937 年金門大橋以空中紡線在 6 個月又 9 天內完成每纜 27,572 根鋼絲。20 世紀後半，工廠預製平行鋼絲索股讓現場作業大幅縮短，本州四國連絡橋的多數懸索橋都採用此法，瀨戶大橋並以起重船牽引導索；1998 年明石海峽大橋首度使用 1,770 MPa 級鋼絲，同年大貝爾特東橋仍以空中紡線完成。2012 年美國聯邦公路總署整理了主纜檢查與強度評估的入門手冊。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Spinning parallel wires into a cable on site was developed by the Roeblings in the 19th century, and the Brooklyn Bridge, opened in 1883, was the first to spin galvanised steel wire; in 1937 the Golden Gate Bridge spun 27,572 wires per cable in six months and nine days. In the second half of the 20th century factory-prefabricated parallel-wire strands greatly shortened site work, and most Honshu-Shikoku suspension bridges used them, Seto Ohashi carrying its pilot rope across by crane ship; in 1998 Akashi Kaikyo first used 1,770 MPa class wire, while the Great Belt East Bridge of the same year was still air-spun. In 2012 the US Federal Highway Administration published a primer on cable inspection and strength evaluation. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 預製平行鋼絲索股常見每股 127 根鋼絲，明石海峽、瀨戶大橋與 1915 恰納卡萊大橋皆採用~Prefabricated parallel-wire strands commonly hold 127 wires, as on Akashi Kaikyo, Seto Ohashi and the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge
金門大橋每纜 27,572 根 0.192 in 鋼絲、61 束，紡線歷時 6 個月又 9 天~Golden Gate has 27,572 wires of 0.192 in in 61 strands per cable, spun in six months and nine days
大貝爾特東橋每纜 18,648 根 5.38 mm 鋼絲，在錨碇分成 37 束~The Great Belt East Bridge has 18,648 wires of 5.38 mm per cable, split into 37 bundles at the anchorages
明石海峽大橋每纜 290 股 × 127 根 5.23 mm 鋼絲~Akashi Kaikyo has 290 strands of 127 wires of 5.23 mm per cable
瀨戶大橋索股捲盤重近 40 t，以貨運列車運輸；貓道寬 4.5 m~Seto Ohashi strand reels weighed nearly 40 t and travelled by freight train; catwalks were 4.5 m wide

日本約半世紀使用 1,570 MPa 級鋼絲，1,770 MPa 級首用於明石海峽大橋，1,960 MPa 級用於 1915 恰納卡萊大橋~Japan used 1,570 MPa wire for about half a century; 1,770 MPa was first used on Akashi Kaikyo and 1,960 MPa class on the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge
長大橋鋼絲鍍鋅量一般在 300 g/m² 以上~Long-span bridge wire usually carries 300 g/m² or more of zinc
